what: Provider-reported usage extracted verbatim from every saved response.
why: The full corpus of 575 request/response pairs is 43 MB and lives in an ephemeral job directory, so it cannot be committed and will not survive. Everything a cost reconstruction needs is the usage block, the model and the created timestamp, which is 164 KB. This file is the primary evidence the derived figures in this campaign rest on.
source_corpus_note: EPHEMERAL. Deleted when the job is deleted.
